title: You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning
role: Score-function token boundary learning; original work uses language-model loss. Our standalone terminal vocabulary objective is an adaptation, not an exact reproduction or refutation.

title: Evolution Strategies as a Scalable Alternative to Reinforcement Learning
role: Parameter-space sampling as a way to avoid long action-score sums; no claimed exact reproduction.

title: The Cross-Entropy Method for Combinatorial and Continuous Optimization
role: Adaptive elite search control. Our implementation fixes proposal variance and smooths the elite mean; it is not the full original algorithm or an exhaustive hyperparameter-tuned CEM benchmark.

title: Tokenization Is More Than Compression
role: Unmodified author PathPiece implementation and same-vocabulary inference control. Shorter sequences alone do not establish downstream benefits.

title: Greed is All You Need: An Evaluation of Tokenizer Inference Methods
role: Intrinsic inference comparisons and original author information-metric code, pinned in the inherited v6/v7 baseline setup.
